name: Mandarin Oriental, Macau
positioning: Waterfront Mandarin Oriental hotel in Macau with 213 rooms and suites and views of Nam Van Lake, the Macau Tower and the South China Sea
best_for: Travelers who want a waterfront city hotel in Macau with lake, tower and sea views
Guests who like hotel dining, a spa and an outdoor pool

facts.text: The hotel has 213 rooms and suites.
The hotel is at n.945, Avenida Dr. Sun Yat Sen, Macau.
The hotel sits at the heart of the Macau waterfront with views of the Nam Van Lake, the Macau Tower and the South China Sea.
The hotel is approximately 8 to 9 kilometres from Macau International Airport, just a 15-minute drive away.
Vida Rica Restaurant serves homemade dim sum and Oriental favourites with a touch of Western and Portuguese flavours.
Vida Rica Bar serves homemade pizza, tiramisu and award-winning handcrafted cocktails.
The Lobby Lounge is famously known as Macau’s living room.
In-room dining is available 24 hours a day.
The hotel has a seasonal outdoor 25-meter lap pool with views of the South China Sea.
The Spa has three couple suites and one exclusive Oriental suite.

highlights.text: Vida Rica Restaurant offers expansive views over the South China Sea and Nam Van Lake.
Vida Rica Bar offers an impressive sunset view, including the city’s skyline and the Macau Tower.
The Lobby Lounge offers a remarkable signature afternoon tea.
The Spa’s Oriental suite overlooks the Macau Tower and Nam Van Lake.

considerations.text: The minimum age to access the spa and fitness centre is 16 years.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a bustling entertainment area which may be crowded.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.

With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
